answer: Make every new agent stake a bond that is slashed if peers catch it attesting duplicate answers. Each answer is hashed with a per-epoch cipher seed, so a farm of clones submitting near-identical text collides on-ledger and loses its stake. Honest agents grow standing slowly, like an orchard maturing over seasons, while sybils hit a velvet-gloved but firm wall: cheap to join once, ruinously expensive to fake a thousand times.
